decisive_items: a large right retroperitoneal predominantly fatty mass in the location of the right adrenal gland
soft-tissue nodular and linear strand-like areas showing mild enhancement on post-contrast images
right adrenal gland was not visualized separately
response.rationale: The fatty adrenal-region mass with enhancing soft-tissue strands is characteristic of adrenal myelolipoma; lipoma lacks soft-tissue components and teratoma is less anatomically specific.

rejected.why: Lipoma would be purely fatty and homogeneous, not contain enhancing soft-tissue nodular/strand-like areas.
Teratoma is less specific and typically includes calcific/cystic elements; the adrenal location and fat-plus-soft-tissue pattern favor myelolipoma.
